description: Standardize biomarker test names and units across different labs. Resolves aliases ("A1C" → "HbA1c", "LDL-C" → "LDL Cholesterol") and converts units to standard clinical format. Costs 1 credit per biomarker.

biomarkers.description: Array of biomarker entries with potentially non-standard names

name.description: Raw test name as it appears on the lab report

unit.description: Unit as it appears on the report
